title: regional-compactor-and-spill-rationer-for-kv-cache
author: Asha Raman
release_notes: Improves KV cache fragmentation recovery and reduces cross-tenant spill IO by ~30-40% under bursty workloads. Adds regional compaction scheduler and spill rationer config knobs.
description:
Context: We observed recurring multi-tenant incidents where the KV cache produced high spill IO bursts caused by fragmentation hotspots and synchronized eviction windows. Existing heuristics performed global eviction and coarse-grained compaction which either caused noisy neighbor spill or left cold fragments that never reclaimed. This PR implements a region-aware compaction scheduler plus a spill rationer that smooths asynchronous spill IO and prioritizes tenant-local compaction to reduce cross-tenant interference.

What changed (high level):
- Add region-aware compactor (kv/compactor/region_compactor.{cc,h}) that tracks fragmentation score per region and schedules local compaction jobs during low-util windows.
- Introduce spill rationer (kv/spill/rationer.{cc,h}) to cap instantaneous spill throughput and convert excess spill into delayed background migration when safe.
- Scheduler hooks to prefer in-place defragmentation for regions with high reuse probability; fall back to spill when memory pressure is sustained.
- New config knobs: regional_compaction.enabled, regional_compaction.min_fragment_score, spill_rationer.max_burst_tokens, spill_rationer.delay_backoff_ms.
- Tests and benchmarks: unit tests for fragmentation scoring, e2e perf benchmark harness for synthetic tenant churn, and integration test that validates bounded spill throughput under bursty load.

Design notes / algorithm summary:
- Fragmentation score: a lightweight estimator (region_hotness * free_fragment_ratio * age_weight) computed incrementally during eviction scans to avoid global passes. Regions with score > min_fragment_score are enqueued for compaction.
- Compaction policy: compaction is time-sliced using a metronome to avoid long blocking work. Each slice attempts local object relocation within the region and marks relocated ranges as warm to enable immediate reuse. Compaction retries are backoff-limited per-tenant to avoid starvation.
- Spill rationer: rather than immediate unbounded spill writes when eviction pressure spikes, we quantify a per-region spill budget. If budget is exhausted, candidates are queued and converted to lower-priority background migration tasks or reclaimed with a higher eviction penalty, depending on tenant priority. Burst smoothing uses a token-bucket fed by steady-state IO capacity.

Kernel & scheduling integration:
- Introduced a non-blocking async IO path for spill writes that batches small spill candidates into contiguous write vectors to improve kernel I/O efficiency. This reduced syscall overhead and allowed the rationer to make finer-grained decisions.
- Scheduler now exposes a compaction token pool shared across workers; tokens are consumed by compaction slices and replenished on a fixed cadence to guarantee fairness across tenants and shards.

Benchmarks (cluster-scale synthetic):
- Workload: 20 tenants, 50% working set overlap, randomized churn with periodic allocation spikes.
- Baseline: main branch (no regional compaction / unbounded spill).
- Result: median cross-tenant spill IO decreased by 34%, overall spill write bandwidth down 38% during spikes, p95 request latency under memory pressure improved from 420ms -> 310ms, and average background compaction CPU overhead increased by ~6% (acceptable tradeoff).

Testing & CI:
- Unit tests added for fragmentation scoring and rationer token accounting.
- Integration tests run in perf-lab with isolated SSD-backed nodes; tests assert bounded spill bandwidth and no regressions on cold-start memory use.
- CI note: initial run had a flaky integration test (kv_compaction_integration) failing due to timing assumptions; test updated to use condition-based waits and reran. Final CI: all checks green.

Migration / rollout plan:
- Feature gated off by default: regional_compaction.enabled = false. Turn-on plan: staged rollout to Dedicated clusters first, enabling min_fragment_score conservatively (0.6) and monitoring spill metrics.
- Backwards compatibility: config defaults ensure no impact for clusters not enabling the feature. Spill rationer defaults to permissive (max_burst_tokens = large) to avoid accidental throttling.

Commits (summary):
- 1) kv: add region compactor core and interface (initial scaffolding)
- 2) kv: implement fragmentation score and enqueueing
- 3) kv/spill: add rationer token-bucket and async batching path
- 4) runtime: integrate compaction token pool into scheduler
- 5) tests: unit + integration + perf harness updates
- 6) docs: configuration and rollout notes in ops docs

Review conversation (condensed):
- Jared Liu: "Nice direction — fragmentation scoring looks lightweight. Can we make the age_weight adaptive based on allocation rate?"
  - Author: "Agreed; added a follow-up TODO to expose age_weight as a dynamic parameter and instrument it in perf runs. Kept default static for this PR to limit scope."
- Priya Menon: "Compaction slices look good, but worried about long-tail CPU when many regions are queued."
  - Author: "Scheduler token pool enforces a hard cap and we added telemetry counters to surface queued region backlog; added a guard to convert oldest queued compaction to a low-priority background migration if backlog > 1000."
- Carlos Alvarez: "Async spill batching kernel changes could interact with OS-level writeback; did you validate on linux with both ext4 and xfs?"
  - Author: "Yes — perf-lab runs included ext4 and xfs profiles; added an opt-in knob to disable write-vector coalescing if a particular filesystem shows regressions."
- Jared Liu: "Please add an upgrade note for dedicated clusters and mention default off flag."
  - Author: "Added ops doc and release notes."

CI details: initial run: unit and lint passed; integration failed once due to timing; rerun caused green. Key checks: build (pass), unit-tests (pass), integration (pass after fix), lint (pass), perf-suite (pass in nightly).

Merge: Squash and merge on 2025-09-18 by Priya Menon after approvals from Jared and Carlos.

Follow-ups / TODOs:
- EXP-1: make age_weight adaptive (instrumentation + controller)
- EXP-2: expose per-tenant compaction budgets and RBAC controls for enterprise customers

Notes for on-call: enable regional_compaction.enabled=false in hotfix builds; to rollback if production regressions occur, remove feature flag or set spill_rationer.max_burst_tokens to a high value.

Related issues: ENG-3421 (multi-tenant spill incidents), SUP-501 (customer reported spikes).
